assert len(grades) == 'wrong number grades' Generators, yield A generator, instead of returning something, it âyieldsâ something. When you access it, it will âreturnâ the first value generated, then, you can access it again and it will return the next value generated. So, all the values are not generated at the same time and a lot of memory could be saved using this instead of a list with all the values. def myGen(n): yield n yield n + 1 g = myGen(6) â> 6 next(g)
